## Mova 1.6.1

Mova 1.6.1 修复了纯离线 NFO 媒体库中系列级本地图片无法显示的问题。对于视频位于 `Season 01`、`S01` 或 `第1季` 等季目录的电视剧，扫描器现在会把已通过媒体库归属校验并被稳定选中的 `tvshow.nfo` 所在目录作为系列图片容器；即使 NFO 没有图片元素，也可以发现同目录中的 `poster / folder / cover`、`fanart / backdrop / background` 和 `clearlogo / logo`。

显式写入 NFO 的图片引用仍保持最高优先级，扫描器不会从单集路径盲目跨目录寻找图片。系列容器图片也已加入 sidecar 指纹，因此新增、修改或删除这些文件都会在下一次扫描时触发本地元数据重新分析，并清理已经失效的约定图片路径。

本版本不修改公开 HTTP/SSE 契约，不包含数据库迁移，也不要求重建缓存。升级后，只需重新扫描需要拾取系列级本地图片的媒体库；其他媒体库无需重扫。

---

## Mova 1.6.1

Mova 1.6.1 fixes missing series-level local artwork in fully offline NFO libraries. When episode files live under season directories such as `Season 01`, `S01`, or `第1季`, the scanner now treats the directory containing the selected, library-owned `tvshow.nfo` as the series artwork container. Even when the NFO has no artwork elements, Mova can discover sibling `poster / folder / cover`, `fanart / backdrop / background`, and `clearlogo / logo` files.

Explicit artwork references in the NFO remain authoritative, and the scanner never guesses an ancestor container directly from an episode path. Series-container artwork is also included in the sidecar fingerprint, so adding, changing, or removing these files triggers local metadata reanalysis on the next scan and clears stale convention-derived paths.

This release does not change the public HTTP or SSE contract, contains no database migration, and requires no cache rebuild. After upgrading, rescan only the libraries that should pick up series-level local artwork; other libraries do not need to be rescanned.
